title: Aakhri Local
synopsis: Anjali, a young nurse, boards the last local after her shift and sees fixer Kisan Mhatre's men push a man off the train. She is left holding his leather pouch. Dinkar Kaka, a retired ticket collector, and Sunny, a street-smart delivery boy, help her stay alive until dawn while Kisan's men search every compartment.
content_advisory: tension and threat, violence only implied, no gore, no strong language
ai_disclosure_note: Story and dialogue written with AI assistance; images, motion, voices and music generated with AI tools.

episodes.title: Aakhri Gaadi
episodes.description: Anjali boards the last local after her night shift and sees something she should never have seen.

episodes.title: Kaka Ki Chaabi
episodes.description: Dinkar hides Anjali using old railway tricks, and a delivery boy leaps aboard at Neelwadi.

episodes.title: Bhaagti Patri
episodes.description: Cornered at Neelwadi, the three escape onto the tracks as Kisan himself steps off the train.

episodes.title: Signal Cabin
episodes.description: In the signal cabin they try to stop the train and call for help, but the line is cut and Dinkar is taken.

episodes.title: Subah Ka Sach
episodes.description: As dawn breaks, Anjali and Sunny reach her hospital and learn why Kaka was really on that train.
